prompt:
PLAN 13 | SHOTS 13A–13D | POSSESSION — INSERT COVERAGE

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Horizontal 16:9.
Exactly four shots lasting four, four, three and four seconds.

These are close inserts covering one shared possession event. Both sisters undergo the same event simultaneously; the cuts reveal different details of that moment.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Zahhak and his living shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}

PROP REFERENCE:
Serpent-headed staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}

Preserve the exact referenced masks and their existing eye openings. The women’s real eyes are visible through these openings. Preserve each woman’s eye color and facial identity.

LOCATION AND LIGHTING:

Interior of a chamber concealed entirely by darkness.

From the first frame, one hard overhead spotlight shines vertically onto the closely grouped characters.

Cold-neutral highlights catch the top planes of the staff carving, mask edges, eyelids, hands and costume folds. Deep shadows fall beneath these surfaces.

The surrounding image remains solid black. Architecture and floor remain unexposed.

Keep the spotlight steady and exposure fixed throughout all four shots. Relight the referenced subjects according to this description.

The staff’s surface reflects the overhead light. The impression of power comes from minute vibration, bodily reactions, framing and sound.

SPATIAL STATE:

Shahrnaz stands WEST.
Arnavaz stands EAST.
Both face NORTH toward Zahhak.

Zahhak stands NORTH of their midpoint, facing SOUTH toward both women.

He holds the staff in his RIGHT hand. Its carved serpent head is centered between the sisters’ sightlines at their eye level, forty centimeters in front of their masks.

Arnavaz’s right hand is empty and hangs beside her right thigh. Her left shoulder retains its established lowered position.

SHOT 13A | 00:00–00:04 | THE STAFF UNDER TENSION

100mm macro lens, approximately f/2.8, extremely shallow depth of field.

Place the camera EAST of the staff head, looking WEST across it. Show the carved serpent head in a tight three-quarter side view, its snout directed toward the sisters, SCREEN-LEFT.

The carving fills most of the horizontal frame. Only its nearest ridge and carved eye lie within the narrow plane of sharp focus. The remaining contours soften into black.

A minute tremor from Zahhak’s gripping hand travels through the rigid staff. The object retains its exact shape and material.

Make a very slow three-centimeter approach, maintaining focus on the same carved ridge.

A hard overhead highlight shifts subtly across the surface as the staff vibrates.

Cut while this restrained vibration continues.

SHOT 13B | 00:04–00:08 | SHAHRNAZ’S EYES

100mm macro close-up from NORTH of Shahrnaz, looking SOUTH at the front of her mask.

Frame tightly across both existing eye openings and the bridge between them. Keep the eyes and nearby mask edges readable; the rest falls into darkness and shallow focus.

At the start, her gaze is fixed slightly toward SCREEN-LEFT, toward the centrally held staff.

Her eyelids flutter subtly. Both eyes slowly roll upward together, exposing more of the natural whites beneath the irises.

Hold this raised gaze briefly as her breath catches.

The irises then return downward into view. Her eyelids settle and her gaze becomes unnaturally still.

Use near-motionless handheld presence. Keep the actual eyes sharp through their movement.

SHOT 13C | 00:08–00:11 | ARNAVAZ’S HAND

85mm close detail of Arnavaz’s RIGHT hand beside her right thigh, photographed from slightly NORTH-EAST of her.

Her hand and the adjacent costume fabric fill the frame. The empty space around them is black.

Her fingers curl inward, gathering a small fold of her own clothing.

A fine tremor passes through the fingertips and wrist. The fabric quivers under the grip.

Then her fingers release together. The gathered fold falls and her hand hangs loose.

Hold the relaxed hand for the final half-second.

Let a small initial handheld tremor settle as her hand becomes still.

SHOT 13D | 00:11–00:15 | ARNAVAZ’S EYES

100mm macro close-up from NORTH of Arnavaz, looking SOUTH at her mask.

Frame the existing eye openings, preserving their exact shape and the surrounding mask texture.

Her initial gaze angles slightly toward SCREEN-RIGHT, toward the same centrally held staff.

Her eyelids tense. Both eyes roll upward together, revealing the natural sclera beneath the irises.

After a brief suspended beat, her eyes return and settle into a calm, fixed gaze.

Hold that stillness.

During the final half-second, her gaze and masked head begin a small turn toward SCREEN-RIGHT, providing an edit point into the later staff-control test.

Keep the motion restrained and anatomically natural.

CONTINUITY AND IMAGE:

The eye-whitening effect comes from the eyeballs rotating upward and exposing their natural whites.

Preserve the masks’ existing openings throughout.

All four inserts belong to the same dark lighting state and the same shared act of possession.

The carved staff head remains rigid. Whenever any living serpent on Zahhak enters an edge of frame, it retains subtle muscular motion and single-headed anatomy.

Use tactile analog detail, hard overhead illumination and narrow, deliberate focus.

SOUND:

Shot 13A:
Faint tension from Zahhak’s grip and restrained breathing outside the frame.

Shot 13B:
Shahrnaz’s caught breath followed by a slow exhalation.

Shot 13C:
Cloth tightening beneath fingers, then softly releasing.

Shot 13D:
Arnavaz’s shallow inhalation settling into calm breathing.

End on the image, ready for an editorial cut.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Zahhak (CHR-001 V08); match it wherever Zahhak appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
